mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(A.EPISODE, '%y년 %m월 %d일') AS episode, B.USER_ID AS userId, A.LOCATION AS location FROM MEETING_SCHEDULE A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) B ON A.EPISODE = B.EPISODE WHERE A.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'N' AND A.EPISODE > DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -1 HOUR) ORDER BY A.EPISODE ASC

SELECT episode from MEETING_SCHEDULE WHERE EPISODE = DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{episode}, '%y년 %m월 %d일'), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AND HEADCOUNT/2 > ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PARTICIPANT_USER A WHERE A.EPISODE = DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{episode}, '%y년 %m월 %d일'), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') AND A.SEX = (SELECT SEX FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARTICIPANT_USER(USER_ID, EPISODE, SEX, NICKNAME) VALUES( #{userId} , DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{episode} , '%y년 %m월 %d일'), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') , (SELECT SEX FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) ,(SELECT AA.VALUE1 AS NICKNAME FROM ( SELECT VALUE1, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS ROWNUM FROM CRITERIA_DATA WHERE DIVISION = ( SELECT CASE WHEN SEX = '남성' THEN 'male_nickname' ELSE 'female_nickname' END FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) AND VALUE1 NOT IN (SELECT NICKNAME FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE EPISODE = DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{episode}, '%y년 %m월 %d일'), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00')) ) AA WHERE ROWNUM = 1) )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EPISODE = DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(#{episode}, '%y년 %m월 %d일'), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00')
mapper.select: SELECT pass_flag FROM user_manage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND PASS_FLAG = 'Y'

SELECT NICKNAME, EPISODE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE EPISODE = ( SELECT AA.EPISODE FROM ( SELECT EPISODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS ROWNUM FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID =#{userId} ORDER BY EPISODE DESC )AA WHERE AA.ROWNUM =1 ) AND SEX <> (SELECT SEX FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID =#{userId})
